name: Anglerfish
description: The Winterworks anglerfish: a dark, velvety, lumpy deep-sea fish with a huge underbite jaw of long glassy needle fangs, small milky round eyes, ragged torn fins, and a stalk arching over its head to a cyan-white bioluminescent lure with trailing filaments and a soft halo. Drawn at the female's size (males at 1/7). Minecraft pixel units, density 2: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
author: lowpix example
